handling.guidance: One dose, taken at a moment: a fact that an intake happened, not a statement about a course. drug is the generic name in lower case, the one spelling health.medication-started fixes for the substance (melatonin, paracetamol), so a dose and its regimen share the drug's name. amount and unit are the quantity taken as the pack states it (5 and mg), never a daily total. taken_at is when it was taken, to the minute, in Australia/Sydney; a time worked out rather than read (bedtime, with the hour unknown) is still the time, and source_note says how. course ties the dose to a known regimen's course and is left out for an as-needed or one-off dose; reason says why it was taken when there is no course. The id is declared in identity_template, <source>:med/<drug-slug>/dose/<taken_at as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM>, and every writer builds it from there: leave id out and Anam fills it; send it and it must match. A dose never appears in the meds regimen projection; the doses projection reads them back at their time.

schema.description: One dose of a medicine taken at a moment, as a point fact outside the regimen series. Written from the person's own word, through a conversation or a records file.

amount.description: The quantity taken, in unit: the strength on the pack times what was taken.

course.description: The course of this drug the dose belongs to, counting as the regimen does, when the dose is part of a known course. Left out for an as-needed or one-off dose. An annotation the reader may use, not a reference the gate enforces.

drug.description: The generic drug name in lower case, as the regimen's writer normalised it, so a dose and its course share one spelling.

id.description: Identity, composed from the rest by the Definition's identity_template: the source prefix, then med, the drug, dose and the moment. A writer may leave it out and Anam fills it; one that sends it must send exactly the composition.

reason.description: Why it was taken, for a dose that belongs to no course, in the person's words.

source_note.description: How the dose was recorded and what the time rests on: said in conversation the next morning, read from a diary, worked out from bedtime. Reader's text, not the source's.

taken_at.description: When the dose was taken, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in Australia/Sydney. This is the fact time.

unit.description: The unit of amount, as the pack states it.
